title: Red Hat Security Advisory: freerdp security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in FreeRDP, a free implementation of the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). These include denial of service conditions via crafted commands and out-of-bounds reads, as well as remote code execution through heap buffer overflows and uninitialized heap memory disclosure. The vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8 variants and have been rated with an important security impact by Red Hat. Updates addressing these issues are available.
